        "prose": "{{ar:لَشَدِيدٌ}} ({{tr:la-shadidun}}) is the ayah's final verdict. The prefixed emphatic lam closes the inna frame, and the nominative adjective functions as the predicate, not as a modifier of the genitive love phrase. That grammar identifies the human as vehemently intense in relation to {{ar:حُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ}} ({{tr:hubbi al-khayri}}), rather than merely describing the love phrase itself. The root {{ar:ش د د}} ({{tr:sh-d-d}}) brings firmness, tightening, strength, and severity into the judgment, so the love of a positive-sounding object becomes excessive and hard-set. The indefinite ending leaves the degree open while the final cadence lets the verdict land as a self-contained close, and the doubled d pressure makes the tightening audible at the ayah's end. Across the boundary, the 100:8 predicate near-echoes the witness predicate in 100:7 through shared initial sound, fa'il shape, and close terminal cadence: the one who is witness is also vehemently attached. The contrast with 2:165 shows that intensity of love is evaluated by orientation, and the inward intensity named here points forward to the exposure of what is in breasts in 100:10.",

      "activated_readings_md": "1. **Attachment hardened into restraint.** Evidence: ح ب ب B002 love/clinging attachment; خ ي ر B001 desired good and B005 beneficence/gift; ش د د B001 fastening a bond and B002 intensity/hardness. Structural cue: repeated \"and indeed he\" ties witness to intense love. Role: love attaches; \"good\" is the desired object; شد makes the attachment hard and binding. Abductive move: what should circulate as beneficence becomes privately fastened to the self. Reading change: the ayah reads as possessive fixation on benefit, not simply liking wealth/good.\n\n2. **Seed/kernel economy.** Evidence: ح ب ب B001 seed-grain/kernel and B004 heart's inner kernel; خ ي ر B002 choice excellence and B003 choosing; ح ص ل B002 extracting kernel/value; ص د ر B001 chest. Structural cue: later 100:10 will extract what is in breasts. Role: hubb supplies both love and kernel; khayr supplies selected value; tahsil later exposes the kernel. Abductive move: desire has an inner seed lodged in the chest that later extraction will sort. Reading change: the ayah becomes a statement about the heart's concealed kernel of valuation.\n\n3. **Charge mirrored inward.** Evidence: ش د د B003 forceful charge/running; ع د و B002 running; ض ب ح B001 breath; ج م ع B010 gathering force; ح ب ب B005 camel fixed by exhaustion. Structural cue: the opening kinetic sequence returns in the moral predicate \"shadid.\" Role: shiddah carries both martial force and hardened intensity; hubb can immobilize like an exhausted animal. Abductive move: the same force that drives the runners also knots the human inwardly, producing both charge and stuckness. Reading change: the verse mirrors the opening: the human is a battlefield of desire's charge.",
      "retrospective_surprises_md": "100:10 was decisive: حب as kernel/heart-core became stronger once \"what is in the breasts\" was extracted. 100:1-5 also looped back through شدة, making desire a continuation of the opening charge rather than a separate moral aside.",

  "butuncul_okuma_line": {
    "raw_line": "**100:8.** وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, insanın hayra/yarara duyduğu sevginin sertleşip bağa dönüşmesini anlatır; verilmesi ve dolaşması gereken iyilik, benliğe sıkıca bağlanır. Sürpriz okuma, حب’in çekirdek/kalp özü dallarıyla gelir: 100:10’da göğüslerdeki şey çıkarıldığında bu sevgi, kalpte saklanan değer tohumu olarak belirir. {ح ب ب B001; ح ب ب B002; ح ب ب B004; ح ب ب B005; خ ي ر B001; خ ي ر B002; خ ي ر B003; خ ي ر B005; ش د د B001; ش د د B002; ش د د B003; ح ص ل B002; ص د ر B001}",

  "v12_reader_walks": {
    "reader_b": {
      "activated_readings_md": "1. **Knowing triggered by overturned concealment.** Evidence: ع ل م B001 knowing as clarity; ب ع ث ر B001 upturning buried contents; ق ب ر B001 grave; و ر ي B005 hiding/covering. Structural cue: interrogative \"does he not know\" is linked to \"when\" graves are opened. Role: knowledge is not voluntary introspection; it is caused by material inversion. Abductive move: the human's present ignorance persists because contents remain covered, and knowledge arrives when covering fails. Reading change: the ayah reads as knowledge by forced event, not mere instruction.\n\n2. **Marks and landmarks exposed.** Evidence: ع ل م B002 distinguishing mark/sign; ق ب ر B002 sunken hiddenness; ث و ر B001 bursting up; ن ق ع B004 raised dust. Structural cue: earlier dust and stirred earth prefigure grave-upturning. Role: buried things become علامات, visible markers of what was hidden. Abductive move: resurrection is also semiotic: the ground's contents become signs pointing to prior lives. Reading change: the ayah reads as the production of evidence-marks from underground.\n\n3. **Scattered inventory disorder.** Evidence: ب ع ث ر B002 scattering belongings into disorder; ج م ع B001 gathering scattered parts and B009 wholeness; ح ص ل B001 resolving the resultant remainder. Structural cue: 100:9 disperses, 100:10 collects/resolves. Role: ba'thara first breaks the grave's ordered concealment into visible scatter; tahsil later makes an account from it. Abductive move: disclosure may begin as disorder before judgment makes it legible. Reading change: the verse becomes the disruptive phase of an audit.",
      "retrospective_surprises_md": "100:10 immediately corrected the disorder of بعثرة: the scattering of graves is not the final form of knowing but the first phase before تحصيل. 100:11 then located the completed knowledge in خبير, so 100:9 reads as a question about delayed but inevitable epistemic conversion.",
      "turkish_prose_synthesis_md": null,
      "source_file": "latent_activation/v12/runs/s100/full_context_control/reader_s100_b_ayah_walk.md"
    }
  },
  "butuncul_okuma_line": {
    "raw_line": "**100:9.** ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ — Birincil okuma: Bilme, burada öğütle değil örtünün zorla ters çevrilmesiyle gelir; kabirler açılınca saklı içerik bilgiye dönüşür. İkincil değişim, بعثر’in saçma ve ح ص ل’in toplama dallarıyla oluşur: açığa çıkarma önce dağınık bir envanter üretir, ardından 100:10’da bu dağınıklık hesaba bağlanır. {ع ل م B001; ع ل م B002; ب ع ث ر B001; ب ع ث ر B002; ق ب ر B001; ق ب ر B002; و ر ي B005; ث و ر B001; ن ق ع B004; ج م ع B001; ح ص ل B001}",
    "arabic_text": "۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ",
    "reading_text_tr": "Bilme, burada öğütle değil örtünün zorla ters çevrilmesiyle gelir; kabirler açılınca saklı içerik bilgiye dönüşür.     {
      "parent_channel": "Water Collection, Surface, and Use",

      "ayah_anchors": "100:4 `نَقْعًا`; 100:6, 100:11 `رَبّ`; 100:9 `يَعْلَمُ`; 100:11 `خَبِيرٌ`",
      "synthesis": "Receptive terrain is the setting, settling is the process, and abundant stored water is the outcome. The well and sea senses scale the same collection principle from bounded source to immense body.",

        "100:11",
        "100:9"
      ]
    },

      "activated_readings_md": "1. **Inner audit-result.** Evidence: ح ص ل B001 collecting until outcome clear; ص د ر B001 chest as bodily front; ش ه د B002 testimony; خ ب ر B001 tested inner knowledge. Abductive move: physical resurrection alone is insufficient; the decisive remainder is the inward result. Reading change: the ayah reads as extraction of a final account from the chest.\n\n2. **Kernel from husk.** Evidence: ح ص ل B002 bringing out inner value from covering; ح ب ب B001 seed/kernel and B004 heart-kernel; ق ب ر B002 hollow/hiddenness. Structural cue: the preceding grave is an outer container; the breast is another container. Role: tahsil separates kernel from casing. Abductive move: desire and intention are embedded like grain in husk, requiring processing. Reading change: the ayah becomes agricultural/mineral extraction of the true inner substance.\n\n3. **Departure from water-source inverted.** Evidence: ص د ر B003 departing after coming to water; ن ق ع B002 water that quenches, B008 experienced water-hole drinker; خ ب ر B002 soft low water-gathering ground. Structural cue: the packet repeatedly activates water-place imagery under dust/raid. Role: sudur can echo places/routes of issuing after watering; tahsil retrieves what leaves or issues. Abductive move: the heart's outputs reveal what it drank from and what satisfied it. Reading change: the verse reads as tracing outward conduct back to its inner watering-source.",

    "raw_line": "**100:10.** وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, göğüslerdeki saklı içeriğin toplanıp sonucunun belirginleştirilmesi, yani iç muhasebenin çıkarılmasıdır. Sürpriz değişim, ح ص ل’in kabuktan öz çıkarma ve صدر’in su başından dönüş dallarıyla gelir: kalpteki değer çekirdeği ayrıştırılır, dış davranışın hangi iç kaynaktan beslendiği geriye doğru izlenir. {ح ص ل B001; ح ص ل B002; ص د ر B001; ص د ر B003; ح ب ب B001; ح ب ب B004; ق ب ر B002; ن ق ع B002; ن ق ع B008; خ ب ر B001; خ ب ر B002}",

    "reader_b": {
      "activated_readings_md": "1. **Nurturing owner as tested knower.** Evidence: ر ب ب B001 lordship/ownership and B002 nurture/completion; خ ب ر B001 report, inquiry, tested inner knowledge. Structural cue: rabb appears in 100:6 as the one toward whom the human is kanud, and returns with plural pronouns after exposure. Role: Rabb is both caretaker-owner and expert examiner; khabir names inward verified knowledge. Abductive move: the one who nurtured the process stage by stage is uniquely competent to know its results. Reading change: the final ayah reads as care-based expertise, not detached surveillance alone.\n\n2. **Soft ground receiving the revealed contents.** Evidence: خ ب ر B002 soft low water-gathering ground; ر ب ب B013 abundant collected water and B008 low cloud; ن ق ع B001 settled water, B007 level clay flats. Structural cue: the surah's hard/dusty motion is countered by low wet gathering imagery in the final name. Role: khabir as soft ground receives what has been churned up; rabb branches supply cloud/water nurture. Abductive move: divine knowledge is like a receptive low place where dispersed evidence settles and becomes knowable. Reading change: \"khabir\" gains an environmental mechanism of gathering and absorbing traces.\n\n3. **Covenant breached and expertly known.** Evidence: ر ب ب B011 covenant/pact, B016 need/favor, B001 authority; ك ن د B001 severing and B002 ingratitude; ش ه د B002 testimony. Structural cue: 100:6 states ingratitude \"to his Rabb\"; 100:11 closes with their Rabb knowing them. Role: Rabb as covenant-holder frames kanud as breach of protected relation. Abductive move: favor creates an implicit pact; cutting gratitude violates it and calls for expert testimony. Reading change: the final ayah reads as covenantal disclosure: the Lord knows the breach from inside the relation.",
      "retrospective_surprises_md": "As the final ayah, it received rather than sent later activation. Its retrospective surprise is internal: prior dust, water, grave, chest, witness, and covenant branches all converge in خبير, making the divine knowledge feel like the surah's collecting basin and final expert verdict.",
      "turkish_prose_synthesis_md": null,
      "source_file": "latent_activation/v12/runs/s100/full_context_control/reader_s100_b_ayah_walk.md"
    }
  },
  "butuncul_okuma_line": {
    "raw_line": "**100:11.** إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ — Birincil okuma: Son ayet, Rabb’i hem sahip-terbiye edici hem de denenmiş iç bilgiye sahip uzman olarak gösterir; insanı yetiştiren, onun sonucunu en içeriden bilir. Sürpriz okuma, خبير’in yumuşak alçak zemin ve ربّ’in su/bulut/ahid dallarıyla gelir: bütün toz, kabir, göğüs, şahitlik ve nankörlük izleri sonunda ilahî bilginin toplama havzasında yerleşir. {ر ب ب B001; ر ب ب B002; ر ب ب B008; ر ب ب B011; ر ب ب B013; ر ب ب B016; خ ب ر B001; خ ب ر B002; ك ن د B001; ك ن د B002; ش ه د B002}",
